Per me teper informacione na kontaktoni!
description_en: 2+1+2 apartment for sale "Orbital Apartments"!! 2+1 apartment for sale at the Orbital complex, at "Bulevardi i Ri". The apartment is located on the 6th residential floor. It is organized in a spacious living room with a balcony, two bedrooms with a balcony, a storage room and two toilets. It has a very regular layout and organization. It is currently in the plastering stage. The works will be completed at the end of 2026. For more information, contact us!
